title: Evidence-coding dataset and reproducible D-by-V heatmap for intelligent process-parameter decision-making in polymer injection molding
description: Supporting evidence dataset and reproducible Figure 4 workflow for the review "Intelligent Process Parameter Decision-Making in Polymer Injection Molding: From Initial Setting to In-Process Adaptation". Version 1.2.0 supports the accompanying review and aligns manuscript-local reference numbering and authentic search documentation. It retains the same 151 primary research publications, stable source identifiers, author-confirmed D/V assignments and D-by-V matrix as the corresponding evidence set in version 1.1.0. Searches and bounded incremental updates were completed by 1 November 2026; authentic historical execution dates and coverage windows are retained. The bounded 28 October–1 November update added no newly included study. The package contains English S1, matching evidence and search-method CSVs, plotting input, Python script, dependencies, reference heatmap, licenses and checksums. D and V refer to the same application; frequencies describe this selected structured narrative-review evidence set rather than field-wide prevalence. No literature full texts, private individual review records, permissions, editorial correspondence or raw proprietary-database exports are included. Data and documentation are CC BY 4.0; Python code is MIT. OpenAI Codex (GPT-6.1) assisted author-led script updating and consistency checks; scientific assignments remain author-confirmed.
